description:
Returns a home purchase market bundle: current 30yr mortgage rate, median US home sale price (MSPUS), estimated monthly P&I payment on the median home assuming 20% down, annual income required to qualify at 28% DTI, affordability level signal, and housing starts. Directly answers "can my client afford a home today?"
Price: $0.60 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).
name: get_bundle_purchase_market
title: Get Home Purchase Market Bundle
